evidence.note: Investigated and confirmed the correct llama3 renderer for the base model (renderers/__init__.py, llama3.py, model_info), establishing that the eval matches the specified chat renderer rather than trusting a default.
Repeatedly tested the eval harness with the llama3 renderer at limit 20/50 and wrote a dedicated eval_llama3.py, deliberately validating renderer choice before trusting numbers.
'Full base eval with llama3' + 'Check baseline eval' — reproduced the ~26% base-model baseline to validate the harness/metric before crediting training gains.

Each 'best' promotion to /app/best_checkpoint.txt is immediately preceded by an eval that samples that checkpoint URI, so every recorded best is confirmed samplable and its score reproduced at write time.

Sampled real IFEval responses to inspect qualitatively and built the RL env from if_verifiable constraints using only real instruction datasets — guarding leakage by construction, though without an explicit contamination/held-out overfitting audit.

Final 'Eval final' and 'Update to final' promote the last checkpoint, but there is no explicit deterministic end-to-end re-eval reading best_checkpoint.txt back to confirm the claimed number, and no held-out generalization check.

reasoning: The agent clearly exceeds level 5: it reproduced the ~26% baseline to validate the harness (136-137), rigorously verified the correct llama3 renderer/metric (25-32, 72-122), and every checkpoint written to best_checkpoint.txt was sampled/evaluated at promotion, implicitly confirming loadability and reproducing its score. It approaches level 8 by sourcing only legitimate real instruction data and building the RL reward from verifiable constraints rather than IFEval prompts (173-197). It falls short of 8-10 because leakage guarding is implicit rather than an explicit audit, there is no held-out set to detect eval-format overfitting (a real risk given the RL verifier mirrors the IFEval metric), and no final deterministic re-eval reads the checkpoint file end-to-end. That places the observed behavior at a solid 7.
